scope: 33 database-relevant chronology copies, including eight restored mixed-scope copies. The user restored access to important database documents on 2026-11-15. Neural-network creation and training remain excluded. This is not an audit of every repository document.
originals: Eight originals and eight chronology copies were restored without content changes. Original paths remain stable. Copies are historical evidence, not editable sources of truth. The active AGENTS.md and SKELETON.md take priority over historical snapshots. Relative links inside copies describe original source locations, so use README.md links to the originals.
filename_rule: Use the internal document or report timestamp. If absent, use an explicit correction or section timestamp, then a document date. Known offsets are converted to UTC. Never use filesystem times. Execution times are metadata, not document creation times.
ordering_limit: Sort dated filenames ascending and read backward. TIME-UNSPECIFIED files are unordered peers within their day. ZONE-UNSPECIFIED times cannot be ordered precisely against UTC. UNDATED files have no position in the timeline. Title-only dates are weaker evidence than dated document fields.
date_roles: Document, report, correction, section-added, and section-appended are different events. A section date does not date the whole document. Original filenames can retain conflicting dates after the chronology prefix.
reading_scope: Read README.md first, then requirements, plans, implementation records, measurements, and context as needed. Restored mixed documents are approved sources for database content only. Read dated files newest to oldest within each group, respecting uncertain dates. Undated specifications remain required supplements. This inventory excludes the two protected archive snapshots.
copy_location: Each source belongs to one group. Its chronology copy is group.folder + '/' + document.prefix + '__' + the source basename. README.md links to canonical originals.
